## Request notification

Convex signs this webhook with `LENDLOOP_OUTBOUND_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.
This workflow signs callbacks with `LENDLOOP_INBOUND_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

Both values live in the n8n environment, not in this file.

After import, set the error workflow to **LendLoop error handler**, then publish. Copy the production URL (`/webhook/lendloop-request`) into the Convex env var `N8N_WEBHOOK_URL`.

Optional: set `NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_URL` to a Slack-compatible incoming webhook. The posted body is only `{ text }`.
